messages.subject: unmarked 0.8-6 released
parts:
Dear all,

Richard and I are pleased to announce the release of unmarked 0.8-6 on
CRAN. The full set of changes is available at
http://github.com/ianfiske/unmarked/commits/master, but the key
changes are

(*) parboot() can now simulate the distribution of arbitrary
statistics. See help for details.
(*) Added offset() handling to model formulae. Useful for plot areas
and hypothesis tests.
(*) Removed plotArea slot. This is now handled by including an offset
in the formula.
(*) Added CITATION file (now citation("unmarked") gives preliminary
citation instructions).
(*) Profile confidence intervals have improved handling of parameters
on the boundary.
(*) Updates to documentation and vignettes.
(*) Added unit testing framework to improve quality control.

Enjoy! And let the group know if you have any questions about this new release.

Best,
Ian

--
Ian Fiske
